mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1%) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in the past month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate investment and profit growth, leading to negative returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annualized growth is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a potential for monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening economic cycle, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST below 1000 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1000.
